description: RFC 0080 core builtin control. design_pue 0.85. PUE below 1.0 is a physical impossibility - total facility power includes the IT load - so CC-DC-01 is an ERROR. The calcs still compute from it, to facility figures that are too small; only the rule catches it. CC-DC-06 fires as a consequence: the fixture's measured 1.32 is now far more than 15% above the stated design. DC-04 and DC-07 are unchanged.
